name: drachtio-server
description: SIP call processing server controllable via Node.js applications, built on the sofia SIP stack. Provides high-performance SIP engine with programmable control through JavaScript.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Official Docker image at drachtio/drachtio-server:latest tracking main branch. Run with: docker run -d --rm --name drachtio --net=host drachtio/drachtio-server

eval_notes: Programmable SIP server with Node.js API (drachtio-srf framework). Excellent for building agentic SIP applications and testing call processing logic. Prometheus and Homer integration for observability.
